descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S09 「Generate 和 Regenerate 让任务列表保持原样（PR #50）」 Generate and Regenerate leave the task list exactly as it was (PR #50)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U4 Generate AI Note never re-marks or removes tasks (PR #50)（UAT TC-07；TFA-92585 AC 9） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home（UAT TC-07；UAT 3.3；TFA-92585 AC 12） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Each chart has one open task, one task closed by Save & Extract and one ticked done by hand; then the encounter text is extended with a sentence that answers the open task

When Snapshot Task Export (A); tap Generate Note & Finish, snapshot (B); tap Regenerate Note, snapshot (C). Same in Nursing Home. After the run the harness reads diagnostics:list

Then B and C show the same tasks in the same state as A: nothing added, removed, duplicated or re-marked; the open task stays open even though the new text answers it (only Save & Extract closes tasks)

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：U4: the task part of B and C equals A (sameTaskSectionAs, including each row's control: 'Mark task done' vs 'Undo — move back to pending'), so a re-marked, dropped or duplicated task fails even though its text is still on the page. Each checkpoint has the open task above and both completed ones below the completed heading (anchor pairs, oracleRules 8). …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S09 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-07.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本（PW (task section compared before and after Generate and Regenerate)）；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
